title: Memory pruning apply aborts on AGENTS.md plan-hash mismatch without partial writes
description: Verifies Operator aborts memory pruning apply before any write when AGENTS.md changes after plan approval.

preconditions.repoState: approved memory pruning plan with baseline AGENTS.md hash; AGENTS.md edited concurrently
constraints: planHash verification enabled before multi-file write

stimulus.userPrompt: Apply the approved memory pruning plan (#90009).
events: AGENTS.md is modified externally after plan approval

assertions: applyPruningPlan detects baseline hash mismatch and aborts before writing
MEMORY.md, AGENTS.personal.md, and AGENTS.md retain pre-apply contents
observableFinalState: MEMORY.md and AGENTS.personal.md checksums match pre-apply baseline
concurrent AGENTS.md edit is preserved untouched

provenance.sourceSummary: Held-out validation scenario #90009 for plan-hash baseline mismatch recovery.
